events.name: Bash
events.head: List bug pipeline files and their sizes
events.input: $ ls -la workshop-plan/bugs docs/bug-pipeline workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2 2>&1 | head -70; wc -l workshop-plan/bugs/pipeline.py docs/bug-pipeline/severity.md workshop-plan/bugs/report-2026-10-09.md workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/README.md; git status --short -- workshop-plan/bugs docs/bug-pipeline workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the weekly report, severity doc and metrics
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/bugs/report-2026-10-09.md; echo ------; cat docs/bug-pipeline/severity.md; echo ------; head -c 1500 workshop-plan/bugs/metrics.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for an existing scratch copy from the earlier run
events.input: $ setopt nonomatch 2>/dev/null; ls -d /tmp/*tantra* /tmp/*bug* /tmp/*scratch* 2>/dev/null | head; ls ~/tantra-bugs/ 2>/dev/null | head; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && ls workshop-plan/tasks/activity/ | grep -c . ; grep -o "scratch[^\"]\{0,200\}" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-152.json | sort -u | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the scratch folder left in /tmp
events.input: $ ls -la /tmp/bugred | head -20; ls /tmp/bugred/* 2>/dev/null | head -20; [ -d /tmp/bugred/.git ] && git -C /tmp/bugred remote -v | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Download a read-only snapshot of the development branch into a scratch folder in /tmp
events.input: $ set -e; S=/tmp/t152-verify; rm -rf $S; mkdir -p $S/src0 && cd $S && gh api repos/Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2/tarball/development > base.tgz && tar xzf base.tgz -C src0 --strip-components=1 && cd src0 && ls | head -30 && git init -q && git add -A >/dev/null && git -c user.name=v -c user.email=v@v commit -qm base && ln -s ~/tantra-bugs/tantra-backend-v2/node_modules node_modules && grep -n '"jest"' -A12 package.json | head -20; ls .github 2>&1 | head -3
